back: Transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma.
Fusion of a male nucleus from the pollen with the egg nucleus in the ovule, forming a zygote.
Monoecious: male tassel at the top, female ear with silks (styles and stigmas) halfway up; wind-pollinated.
Calyx, standard, two wings, keel enclosing 10 stamens (9 joined + 1 free) and the pistil.
Separate male and female flowers, tassel sheds pollen before the silks are ready (protandry), wind carries pollen.
Keel encloses anthers and stigma, so pollen falls on the same flower's stigma.
Ovule → seed; ovary → fruit; integuments → testa; zygote → embryo.
Wind (wings, hairs), animals (hooks, fleshy fruits), self (explosive pods), water (floating).
Weed before seed set; clean seed, implements and animals; use well-rotted manure.
